intuition: Use every ticket once while always choosing the smallest available destination; Hierholzer's traversal handles detours and cycles.

brute_force.approach: Try ticket permutations from JFK in lexical order until a route consumes every ticket.

optimal.approach: Sort adjacency in reverse lexical order, run iterative Hierholzer traversal, and reverse the postorder route.

edge_cases: Several tickets may share the same origin and destination.
A valid itinerary may revisit airports and contain cycles.
